title: ge16.judgment.v1
description: Verdict about evidence. Many judgments per evidence are allowed; all retained for audit. Unmatched bloc/party/seat strings keep their raw values here and surface separately as entity candidates (never blocking an import).

judge.description: Judge identity as retained by the source. Null where the merged corpus did not keep it.

verifiable.description: origin orphaned-flag (P2.8 F7 owner ruling, blessed): true means "publisher reachable at judgment time" — a liveness check, not a content-accuracy claim.

batch_file.description: Repository-relative path of the surviving artifact backing the judgment, if any.

batch_file_sha256.description: origin judged-batch only: import-time computed sha256 of the batch file itself. This is the verifiable binding — hashing the file named by batch_file yields exactly this value.

embedded_source_sha256.description: origin judged-batch only: the batch document's self-reported source_sha256, kept verbatim. It hashes the judged INPUT generation of ge16-news-backfill-candidates.json at judge time; that generation was overwritten in V2 (P2.1 Finding 2), so it cannot be reproduced from disk. See source_hash_semantics.

source_sha256.description: origin accepted-corpus-inline: sha256 of the accepted-corpus file backing the judgment (import-time computed). origin orphaned-flag (P2.8 F7 owner ruling, blessed): sha256 of the probe input actually judged (the serialized probe result), not a hash of the article body.

source_hash_semantics.description: origin judged-batch only: states which hash is auditor-verifiable and why embedded_source_sha256 points at an overwritten input generation.

verdict_line.description: Compact verdict line when the judgment is derived from verdicts.jsonl (parse_verdicts).
